# Data dictionary

## `data/catalogue.csv` (synthetic; generated by `scripts/generate_data.py`, seed 7)
290 raw rows: 282 generated + 8 deliberately defective rows. After ingestion: **283 valid**, 5 rejected, 1 duplicate removed, 1 quarantined (injection). One valid row (`SYN-9008`) is out of stock on purpose.
| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| item_id | str | `SYN-####` |
| title | str | modifier + base product |
| category / subcategory | str | 10 categories |
| description | str | templated, labelled "synthetic catalogue record" |
| tags | `a|b|c` | canonical interest tags (reading, coffee, …) used for matching |
| price_inr | float > 0 | invented |
| audience | `a|b` | intended audience |
| attributes | JSON | practical, generic_gift, handmade, eco_friendly, premium, base_name |
| availability | enum | in_stock / low_stock / out_of_stock |
| image_url | str | empty (UI uses category placeholder tiles) |
| source | str | always `synthetic` |
| quality_flags | `a|b` | reserved |

Defective rows: duplicate item, missing price, negative price, invalid availability, empty title, non-numeric price, prompt-injection text, plus an out-of-stock strong match.

## `data/evaluation_queries.json`
30 fixed queries: `id, query, expected_interests, oracle_budget_max, oracle_exclusions, kind, expect_status, category`. `oracle_*` fields are hand-written and independent of the parser.

## SQLite (`data/glanceflow.db`)
- `events(event_id, ts, session_id, event_type, ref_id, properties JSON, is_seeded)`
- `shortlist(item_id, saved_at, fit_reason, session_id)`
- `dismissals(item_id, dismissed_at, session_id)`
- `feedback(feedback_id, ts, session_id, item_id, reason)`
- `preferences(key, value JSON, updated_at)`
Event types: session_started, query_submitted, clarification_requested, results_generated, recommendation_viewed, recommendation_saved, comparison_started, recommendation_dismissed, feedback_submitted, query_refined, action_completed, agent_verification_failed (+ `experiment_exposure`). `is_seeded=1` marks demo rows.
